taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts A. syriaca, but its native range does not include Texas.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Current Kew native range excludes Texas.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not treat nursery/planted common milkweed as Texas-native.

morphology.look_here_first: Common milkweed is a tall clonal perennial with broad opposite leaves, large pinkish-purple umbels, and warty follicles; use only as a nonlocal comparison.
